reserves.name: Reverse repurchase agreements collateralized by U.S. Treasury securities

reserveReview.rationale: Deloitte's August 31 examination, signed September 28 (letterhead and signature reviewed visually), reports $176,391,828 reserves against 175,731,350 redeemable USAT: Ethereum 175,534,959 plus Celo 196,391. Reserves comprise $158,914,000 Treasury-collateralized reverse repos with one U.S. broker-dealer, purchased August 31 and maturing September 1, and $17,477,828 cash ($17,227,828 uninsured). Gross surplus is $660,478; $3 redeemed but not paid gives the reported net surplus $660,475.
